headline.purpose: Credits and achievement titles; clamp(1.75rem, 1rem + 2vw, 2.5rem) from 760px. Memory titles and the question's lead sit a step down.

title.purpose: Button labels; 1.5rem from 760px, the Play plank 1.5rem / 1.75rem.

body.purpose: His lines, max 36ch; 1.4375rem from 760px. Her replies on choice planks use 600.

label.purpose: Clock, photo plaque, title ribbon, his name plate; speech bubbles and the title greeting use 1.0625rem.

logo.purpose: The game's name on the title sign, once; cream with a two-layer emboss.

shadows.name: raised-control
shadows.purpose: Buttons, sound toggle, inventory slot. Removed on :active.

shadows.name: panel
shadows.purpose: Dialogue boxes, photo frames, achievement banner.

shadows.name: label-emboss
shadows.purpose: text-shadow on cream wooden-button labels (#7e1427 on Yes).

motion.name: art-pixel-step
motion.purpose: Every offset and bob moves in whole art pixels.

motion.name: two-frame-loop
motion.purpose: Bobs and nudges: arrow 800ms, pointing hand 700ms, star 1400ms, cat hop 280ms (run 180ms), his nervous fidget 760ms.

motion.name: drop
motion.purpose: The title sign and picture frames drop in; a memory's item pops up at 560ms.

motion.name: word-rise
motion.purpose: Headline words rise one by one.

motion.name: depart
motion.purpose: A screen leaves, or the talk box folds away between hours: scale .96 and fade.

motion.name: typewriter
motion.purpose: Dialogue types out; square-wave blip every third letter in the song's key; tap to finish.

motion.name: sky-crossfade
motion.purpose: Time-of-day scene change, once per hour of the story; the clock plate hops.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion: loops stop, text appears whole.

motion.name: flower-burst
motion.value: 170ms per bloom stage, ripple from the tap
motion.purpose: Play covers the screen in pixel flowers, swaps the title for the farm underneath, then fades them in 6 steps over 1800ms.

motion.name: choice-drop
motion.purpose: Her replies drop in one after another.

motion.name: emote-pop
motion.purpose: A reaction bubble pops over a character's head and stays about 1.6s.

motion.name: character-jump
motion.purpose: Gabrielle and Mohaimen jump when she says yes.

motion.name: sprite-tick
motion.purpose: Blinks and his mouth moving (every other tick) while his words type.

I made you a little something. Turn your sound on if you can.

components.name: Emote
components.description: A reaction bubble that pops over a character's head: heart, !, …, sweat drop, music note. Never words.
components.css: .ds-emote-row { display: flex; gap: 24px; align-items: flex-end; padding-top: 40px; } .ds-actor { position: relative; width: 66px; } .ds-actor img { display: block; width: 66px; height: 126px; image-rendering: pixelated; } .ds-mo img { transform: scaleX(-1); } .ds-emote { position: absolute; left: 12px; bottom: calc(100% - 6px); width: 39px; height: 36px; background: url("data:image/png;base64,") 0 0 / 100% 100% no-repeat; image-rendering: pixelated; animation: ds-emote-pop 360ms steps(3, end); } .ds-emote.ds-dots { background-image: url("data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAA0AAAAMCAYAAAC5tzfZAAAAcElEQVR4AaSQMQqAQAwEY1prS8F/6PP1H4KltbXeBNJIhEiEIRtuN/FOpX3z2N9Zml0U87qfkgW/bSL9h3pomQYBtlLhrenrm/wxmPalOatvYkoG3Y6r48IOIddRxW+/hwACDn0E5xZCOEzH7H1UHwAAAP//Z1a9rgAAAAZJREFUAwC5/GHd7kIURQAAAABJRU5ErkJggg=="); } @keyframes ds-emote-pop { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(12px); } 60% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(-3px); } 100% { transform: none; } }

narrative.overview:
The site is a game she plays, not a page she reads. Every surface is a piece of cozy farming-game UI rebuilt from scratch: a hanging wooden title sign and menu, chunky wooden dialogue boxes around parchment with a character portrait, a choice menu with a pointing hand, inventory slots, friendship hearts, emotes, an achievement toast. Behind it all a banded, dithered sky owns the viewport and moves through one in-game day, dawn to festival night, one hour per beat of the conversation. The inspiration is a well-loved farming sim, pinned by the user; the execution is entirely original pixel art drawn in code, and never the game's own assets, fonts, logo, music, or name.

The medium is the art pixel. One art pixel is one `--px` (3px on phones, 4px from 760px up), and every frame, sprite, sky band, shadow offset, and motion step is a whole multiple of it. Frames are generated at runtime as 9-slice PNGs and applied with `border-image`; sprites are drawn into small canvases and scaled up with `image-rendering: pixelated`. The two real photographs are the only rasters shipped and they are the one thing allowed to stay smooth.

Density is low and centered: one dialogue-driven moment per viewport, a HUD in the top-right corner, and a grass strip along the bottom where Gabrielle and Mohaimen stand as pixel characters and the two cats live. Motion is stepped, never tweened: things drop, pop and type in whole-pixel jumps, and text types out with a square-wave blip while the speaker's mouth moves.
keyCharacteristics: One art-pixel unit (`--px`) governs size, offset, shadow and motion.
Wood-framed parchment is the only container; the sky is the only background.
Pixelify Sans everywhere, at weights 500 to 700; no second face.
Hard, zero-blur drop shadows, stepped (notched) corners, no radius anywhere.
Motion in `steps()` easings only; a typewriter with sound, a changing portrait and a choice menu are the signature.
Time of day is the color story: seven scene palettes, one per hour of the story.

rules.name: The Two Reds Rule
rules.body: Heart Red (#e0304e) is for pixels, Text Red (#c8243f) is for type. Never swap them.

rules.name: The Sky Owns The Page Rule
rules.body: No flat or gradient page background: the dithered, banded scene sky is the backdrop, and it changes only when the hour changes (one per beat of the conversation).

rules.name: The No Ligatures Rule
rules.body: Ligatures stay off (`"liga" 0, "clig" 0`): Pixelify's "fi" ligature renders as a block letter.

rules.name: The Color-Not-Italic Rule
rules.body: `*word*` in copy becomes an `em` rendered upright in Text Red. The face has no italic and the world does not fake one.

rules.name: The Faces Stay Clear Rule
rules.body: From a 390×844 phone up, nothing sits on Gabrielle's or Mohaimen's face: not a cat's bubble, not the No button, not a box. Position chrome around them first; only on phones shorter than that may the talk box overlap their heads.

rules.name: The Zero-Blur Rule
rules.body: Every shadow has a blur radius of 0 and a whole-art-pixel offset. A soft shadow does not exist in this world.

rules.name: The Press-Into-The-Hole Rule
rules.body: `:active` = `translateY(var(--px))` and `filter: none`. Nothing scales or glows on press.

rules.name: The Stepped Corner Rule
rules.body: Corners are notched in art pixels, never rounded and never sharp-square on a framed element.

rules.name: The Whole Pixel Rule
rules.body: Every drawn edge sits on the art-pixel grid, and every drawn element carries `image-rendering: pixelated`. Photos are the exception: they must render smooth.

dos: **Do** size, offset and animate everything in multiples of `--px` (3px phone, 4px from 760px).
**Do** draw new frames and sprites in code on the pixel grid with a 1-art-pixel ink outline, and set `image-rendering: pixelated` on them.
**Do** put every container in a wood-and-parchment 9-slice with stepped corners; use gold only for reward moments.
**Do** use `steps()` easing for every transition and animation, and a zero-blur, whole-pixel drop shadow for every raised thing.
**Do** repaint the scene from the time-of-day palette when the hour (the beat of the conversation) changes.
**Do** draw people from the real photos: their actual hair, hat, jackets and colors, in the same outline-and-ellipse grammar as the cats.
**Do** keep Pixelify Sans as the only face, ligatures off, emphasis in Text Red.
donts: **Don't** use the actual game's assets, fonts, logo, music or name; everything is original.
**Don't** pixelate the photographs; they are the only smooth rasters.
**Don't** use border-radius, blurred shadows, gradients, glass or smooth cubic-bezier easing.
**Don't** add a second typeface or use italics.
**Don't** put Heart Red on text or Text Red in pixel art.
**Don't** set a flat page background over the scene sky.
